title: Iliotibial band syndrome - aftercare
claims: MedlinePlus describes a bursa between the tendon and bone on the outside of the leg that can become painful and swollen with repeated rubbing.
MedlinePlus notes early pain may disappear as you warm up, then become worse and persist during exercise as the condition progresses.
MedlinePlus symptom relief includes ice for 15 minutes every 2 to 3 hours, mild heat before stretching, and shortening runs or cycling before stopping them entirely if pain persists.
MedlinePlus says return to running gradually once stretching and strengthening can be done without pain.
MedlinePlus lists poor conditioning, a tight IT band, poor form, no warm-up, bowed legs, activity changes, and core muscle imbalance as other causes.
